title: Concept: Temporary file created without owner-only permissions (java)
description: In java, File.createTempFile creates a file in a shared directory. Between creation and use, another account can read it or swap it, which turns a scratch file into a disclosure or a symlink attack.
applicability: Export jobs, report generation and archive handling; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Local disclosure of exported data and symlink-based file clobbering; MEDIUM severity.
